title: CBDC Ban Has a 2030 Expiration Date
script_summary:
**ORACLE BRIEF**

The Senate's 89-to-10 CBDC ban is theater masking a 2030 sunset clause—DC just scheduled the surveillance war, not ended it.

**Three signals converging:** Arthur Hayes is hedging with Bitcoin and gold, not equities. That positioning matters. Fed rate-cut expectations shifted nine percent to thirty-five percent in three weeks on Iran tensions alone. Tighter money for longer.
